claims.text: Adaptive bias force or metadynamics should be used as the methodological intervention.
Advanced sampling will improve representation of atomic configurations in the ab initio liquid of multicomponent high-entropy alloys.
Advanced sampling will improve phase-space overlap between the reference and target systems.
Enhanced phase-space sampling will improve thermodynamic integration.
Advanced sampling will reduce thermodynamic-integration path mismatch relative to TOR-TILD's EAM references.
The intervention is applicable to both solid and liquid states.
The intervention is applicable from equiatomic to non-equiatomic multicomponent high-entropy-alloy compositions.
The intervention is applicable near and above the melting temperature.
TOR-TILD's EAM references constitute the comparison baseline.
Free-energy differences and phase-space-overlap metrics can be used to compare advanced sampling against TOR-TILD's EAM references.
The hypothesis is falsified if advanced sampling produces neither a significant reduction in path mismatch nor an improvement in phase-space overlap relative to TOR-TILD's EAM references.
